sql:
WITH
  ExampleTable AS (
    SELECT 1 AS id, ['I', 'like', 'pie', 'pie', 'pie', NULL] AS f
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2 AS id, ['yum', 'yum', 'pie', NULL] AS f
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3 AS id, ['I', 'yum', 'pie', NULL] AS f
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4 AS id, ['you', 'like', 'pie', NULL] AS f
  )
SELECT id, ML.TF_IDF(f, 3, 1) OVER () AS results
FROM ExampleTable
ORDER BY id
